# Account

8 routes. Base URL: `https://orbitwrite.com/api/v1`. Paths below are absolute.

| Method | Path | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/v1/account` | Read the signed-in user's profile and preferences |

| GET | `/api/v1/account/emails` | List the signed-in user's email addresses |

| DELETE | `/api/v1/account/emails/{emailId}` | Remove an email address from the account |

### GET /api/v1/account/emails

List the signed-in user's email addresses

Session-only: an email address belongs to a person, and a workspace API key has no person to own one.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Responses**

- `200` — Every address on the account, oldest first
  - `UserEmailList`
    - `emails`: array of `UserEmail`, required
      - `id`: string, required
      - `email`: string, required
      - `verified`: boolean, required
      - `primary`: boolean, required — The address the account signs in with and receives mail at. Exactly one per user.
      - `createdAt`: string, required — ISO 8601.
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`

### POST /api/v1/account/emails

Add an email address to the signed-in user's account

The address starts unverified and a six-digit code is mailed to it. Verify it with `POST /account/emails/{emailId}/verify` within 10 minutes, or request a new code.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)
**Rate limited:** yes (429 when the per-credential budget is spent)

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `AddUserEmailBody`
  - `email`: string (max length 254), required

**Responses**

- `200` — The address was added and a code mailed to it
  - `UserEmail`
    - `id`: string, required
    - `email`: string, required
    - `verified`: boolean, required
    - `primary`: boolean, required — The address the account signs in with and receives mail at. Exactly one per user.
    - `createdAt`: string, required — ISO 8601.
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `409` — Conflicts with an existing resource
  - `Error`
- `429` — Rate limit exceeded
  - `Error`

### POST /api/v1/account/emails/{emailId}/resend

Mail a fresh verification code

Replaces any code still outstanding for the address. Unlike the code sent when the address is added, this send is awaited: a provider failure is reported as a 502 rather than a false success.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)
**Rate limited:** yes (429 when the per-credential budget is spent)

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

| `emailId` | string | yes |  |

**Responses**

- `200` — The mutation was applied

- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`

- `404` — The resource does not exist

- `429` — Rate limit exceeded

### POST /api/v1/account/emails/{emailId}/verify

Verify an email address with its mailed code

A code expires after 10 minutes and allows 5 wrong guesses; the fifth locks it (429) until a new one is requested.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)
**Rate limited:** yes (429 when the per-credential budget is spent)

    - `verified`: boolean, required
    - `primary`: boolean, required — The address the account signs in with and receives mail at. Exactly one per user.
    - `createdAt`: string, required — ISO 8601.

### POST /api/v1/account/emails/{emailId}/primary

Make a verified address the account's primary one

The primary address is what sign-in and account mail use, so it must be verified first. The previous primary stays on the account, demoted.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)
